description: Graph-native instruction understanding and teacher learning. A routed imperative whose grammar parser left as a statement is repaired by a graph rule: its first Mention must resolve to a held instruction-route Concept. This is extensible graph data, not a host verb list; a declarative whose first word is not a route-bearing verb remains a statement. An InstructionInterpretation is always minted before activation; ambiguity holds it and requests clarification; a local grounded interpretation verifies without a teacher. An unresolved residual originates a structured TeacherRequest, ordered held knowledge -> dictionary -> Wikipedia -> LLM. Teacher evidence is never a Message: it is staged as a LessonCandidate, tested by a replay, then adopted through the existing graph-native goal/task seam. All counters and scores are integers.
